source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Substitution: plan row 138 is Quaternius "Spaceship" on the poly.pizza CDN (blocked by a Cloudflare challenge). Used the Striker fighter from Quaternius's Ultimate Spaceships pack (May 2021) on OpenGameArt, CC0 per the page; the .blend is used because it carries the packed texture (the FBX and OBJ reference none). Chosen over the pack's Spitfire and Challenger (also rendered) for the sleekest anime-fighter silhouette: twin forward gun prongs, a central canopy and anhedral wings. Real size: a small one-seat fighter about 12 m long, so the rest height (canopy plus antennas) is 3.8 m, giving 11.9 m long and 7.1 m across. The lowest point is the two wing tips, at y = 0. Painted texture flattened to 10 colours; recoloured as a white/blue mecha fighter with a red canopy and gold trim. Static, no clips.
